      <button bindtap="onConfirmEdit" disabled="{{busy || frozen}}" class="management-primary">

    </button>
    <view wx:if="{{cancelEditingConfirmation}}" class="management-confirmation" aria-role="alert">
      <view class="notice">

      </view>
      <button bindtap="onConfirmCancelEditing" disabled="{{busy}}" class="management-destructive">
        确认撤销原申请

      <button bindtap="onDismissCancelEditing" disabled="{{busy}}" class="management-action">

      </button>

  <button bindtap="onReturnCatalog" class="management-quiet">
